title: TOA NegotiationRecord
description: Client/gateway record of whether a server advertised dev.agentstatus/toa at capability exchange, plus optional out-of-band key pins. Makes offline absence and key-unavailability interpretable.

pinned_public_key_id.description: Client-pinned public_key_id / emitter.key_id expected for this server's attestations.

pinned_key_fingerprint.description: sha256: hex of the raw public key bytes the client trusts for this server.

pinned_emitter_name.description: Optional pin of emitter.name (often with requireEmitter).

transport.description: Transport used for this peer. Stdio does not change who signs; the emitter key does.
